messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@healthspring.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor security profile handoff — initial questionnaire and timelines

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for picking this up. We're migrating our vendor assessment to Vendr and HealthSpring needs a quick security handoff from your side so we can complete procurement. Attached is the initial vendor questionnaire (Whistic export) — you'll see some fields already filled from the inbound scan. Two asks up front: 

1) Do you have a current SOC 2 bridge letter / SOC artifact that we can upload to Vendr (PDF)?
2) Who will own the service account and key rotation for the S3 buckets referenced in CAIQ items? Our auditor will want the rotation policy and a point of contact.

Timeline: procurement is aiming to close the PO by 12/05; if we can get artifacts and a CAIQ map by 11/27 that will keep us on track.

Attachments: HealthSpring_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 230KB)

Would you be able to confirm the steward and a short mutual action plan? Happy to join a 20-min call if that speeds things up.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Head of Security Programs
HealthSpring

--
HealthSpring audit: audit@healthspring.com

Hi Emily — thanks for the context and the questionnaire.

Short answers up front:
- We have a SOC 2 bridge letter (attached) that covers controls through 2025-04. I will confirm whether we can provide a cropped report extract for Vendr.
- Service account / keystore stewardship: proposing Marissa as the primary steward for this handoff; Jordan will support S3 evidence ingestion and the CAIQ row mapping.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (Vendor-MAP-draft.xlsx) with proposed owners and deadlines — please review and suggest adjustments. Proposed timeline: evidence and CAIQ mapping by 11/27, keystore rotation policy by 11/30, audit call the week of 12/01 if needed.

Next steps for us: Marissa will share the SOC artifact and the keystore rotation doc; Jordan will start a CAIQ-to-Whistic field mapping and post a short tracker. Can you confirm if Vendr requires signed attestation or just a PDF upload?

Attachments: Vendor-MAP-draft.xlsx (xlsx, 95KB)

Best,

Subject: SOC 2 bridge letter and keystore rotation plan for Vendr upload

Hi Emily —

Thanks for your patience. Per our plan: attaching our SOC 2 bridge letter and the keystore rotation plan. A few notes to help the Vendr ingest:

- SOC 2 bridge letter is a short PDF that states our last audit period and points to our public SOC page (we do not attach the full SOC 2 report in Vendr by default). If Vendr requires the full report for HealthSpring procurement, please let us know and I will coordinate with Legal for an NDA-first transfer.
- Keystore rotation plan (attached) summarizes the primary KMS provider (AWS KMS), rotation cadence (annual key rotation with monthly key usage rotation for service account tokens), and last rotation date (2025-08-12).
- CAIQ mapping: Jordan created a mapping sheet and dropped a stub at the drive link below (fields mapped where possible; a few CAIQ rows are 'delegated' to infra vendors and flagged). We marked three CAIQ rows that require sample evidence (S3 access logs, IAM role attestation, and encryption-in-transit proof).

Attachments:
- SOC2-bridge-letter-2025-04.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
- keystore-rotation-plan.pdf (pdf, 40KB)

Shared drive (read-only): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz/SecurityEvidence/HealthSpring
Vendr profile link (internal): https://vendr.example.com/profile/healthspring-id-9923

If the auditor wants a short call to review the CAIQ mapping, I'm available 12/02–12/04 afternoons PT. Happy to redact anything that Legal flags.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Programs — Redwood Inference
From: Emily Park <emily.park@healthspring.com>

Marissa — this is perfect, thank you. We'll proceed with the Vendr upload and I will flag the three CAIQ rows for which we need samples. Audit team (cc) may request either log samples or a short attestation — I'll confirm which by 11/27.

Two quick asks: 
1) Can you add a single line in the SOC bridge PDF that lists the contact person for audit follow-ups (name, email, phone)? That speeds the procurement review.
2) For the keystore plan, can you put the last-rotation timestamp in ISO format in the doc (2025-08-12T03:21:00Z) — our ingestion detects timestamps automatically.

If those are small edits can you drop updated files to the drive link. We'll close vendor intake once we have the evidence samples or attestations.

Emily
Head of Security Programs — HealthSpring
